about: Timed cases for the calendar renderer: a stored calendar must not set what one label costs. Each case is a calendar readCalendarConfig accepts, a step, a call (format: formatStep; weekday: weekdayForStep; roundtrip: formatStep, then parseDate of its label) and its words. A string written as {"$repeat": [[piece, times], ...]} is the pieces joined, each repeated. Before 4.201.2 and onlyworlds 0.148.2 the template collapse was cubic on a run of white space, the edge trim quadratic on a run of marks, and a year was built one entry a day: every case here ran past its bound on one of the two packages. Held byte for byte in the Python package's tests/fixtures.
